title: Which One Piece character are you? Straw Hat Pirates quiz — cv.cm
description: Free One Piece quiz: answer 12 questions to find which Straw Hat Pirate you are: Luffy, Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, Chopper, Robin or Franky. No sign-up, unofficial fan quiz.
h1: Which Straw Hat Pirate are you?
lede: Captain, swordsman, navigator or cook? Answer 12 questions about your dreams, habits and weak spots, and find out which member of Luffy's crew you'd be in One Piece.
about: Every Straw Hat joined the crew chasing a dream of their own, and that dream says a lot about who they are: Luffy wants the most freedom on the sea, Zoro to be the world's greatest swordsman, Nami to map the whole world. This quiz matches your dreams, habits and quirks to eight of the crew.

Your result names your Straw Hat and shows your scores for all eight. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Eiichiro Oda, Shueisha or Toei Animation; the names belong to their owners.

faq.a: Eight of the Straw Hat Pirates: Monkey D. Luffy, Roronoa Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, Tony Tony Chopper, Nico Robin and Franky.

faq.q: Why aren't Brook and Jinbe in the quiz?
faq.a: Keeping eight results keeps the quiz short and every result equally easy to get. They may join in a later update.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every character appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

luffy.name: Monkey D. Luffy
luffy.body: Free, fearless and impossible to stop once you've decided something. You follow your gut, you'd fight anyone for your friends, and people end up following you without quite knowing why. Just don't forget to eat something other than meat.

zoro.name: Roronoa Zoro
zoro.body: Focused, loyal and tough as steel. You've picked your goal and you train for it every day, and you never break a promise to a friend. You're calm in a crisis… just maybe let someone else hold the map.

nami.name: Nami
nami.body: Smart, sharp and always three steps ahead, especially where money's involved. You plan the route everyone else follows, and under the tough exterior you'd do anything for the people you call home.

usopp.name: Usopp
usopp.body: Creative, funny and braver than you think. You'd admit you're scared, then show up anyway, and that's real courage. Your stories, your aim and your ideas get the crew out of more trouble than anyone knows.

sanji.name: Sanji
sanji.body: Generous, stylish and fiercely caring. You show love with good food and you'll never let anyone go hungry. You hold yourself to a strict code, and you'd risk everything for your crew.

chopper.name: Tony Tony Chopper
chopper.body: Kind, curious and a little shy, with a huge heart. You want to help and heal everyone, and you're stronger than you look. When someone praises you, you pretend you don't care… and you're terrible at hiding it.

robin.name: Nico Robin
robin.body: Calm, clever and endlessly curious, with a dry sense of humour. You read everything, notice everything and say little. After a lot of life, you've learned what it means to find people who truly have your back.

franky.name: Franky
franky.body: Loud, inventive and full of heart. You can build anything, you do everything big, and you're not shy about how great it is. Under all the style is someone who cries at happy endings and protects the crew like family.
